people.name: Lazarus
people.line: Brother of Mary and Martha; raised from the dead

translations.web: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
translations.bsb: After Jesus had said this, He called out in a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
translations.kjv: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
translations.asv: And when he had thus spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
